Best Buy’s Week 1 Black Friday Doorbuster steal at 54% off: Lenovo’s 2K touchscreen Chromebook hits $189 all-time low
Best Buy is kicking off its early Black Friday deals today, with notable offers landing on pretty much everything from Apple gear, laptops, gaming PCs, and so on. A notable Week 1 Doorbuster deal worth checking out now drops one of Lenovo’s latest 2K touchscreen Lenovo IdeaPad Slim Chromebooks down to $189 shipped . The base variant of this Chromebook with 4GB/64GB config is down to $189 from its $419 price, whereas the more capable 8GB/128GB model is at $289 , down from $529. That’s a massive $230 discount on the base variant, which works out to a massive 54% discount. Both models are hitting new all-time lows today, and the value is pretty hard to ignore at these prices, especially if you’re after an affordable Chromebook for casual, everyday use. Head below for more details.
Lenovo’s IdeaPad Slim 3 Chromebook is a practical pick if you’re looking for a simple everyday notebook for casual use. The more affordable version from the sale today pairs MediaTek’s Kompanio 540 processor with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of UFS storage, while the higher-end model steps up to 8GB of memory and 128GB of storage for a bit more breathing room when multitasking or keeping files offline. Both variants feature a 14-inch WUXGA touchscreen, giving you a little more vertical space than a standard 1080p panel while also making ChromeOS easier to navigate. Both of these variants should be able to handle web apps, documents, streaming, and general productivity workloads without any issues, and Lenovo also rates its battery to last for up to 18 hours on a single charge.
Be sure to check out the rest of Best Buy Week 1 Black Friday Doorbuster deals , which are now live to kick off the holiday savings. Loads of other Windows laptops are also discounted right now, and you’ll find them all highlighted right here .

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Nothing Ear (3a) wireless buds back down at $79 shipped in Black, Pink, White, and Yellow.

All things considered, this is a whole lot of buds for under $80 – we said they are easily some of the best buds you can buy for the price after testing them out and now they are even lower.
We have featured this deal a number of times now, and there is a chance we see some additional savings on them in the coming weeks for Black Friday, but if history is any indication, chances are they won’t drop a whole lot more than this – think $10 or $15 max. That’s not insignificant though, and if you are looking towards the lowest possible price, we will likely see some additional savings across the current-generation Nothing lineup starting next month.
